market_summary: Overall Sentiment: Constructive but bifurcated. The broad market (S&P, Dow, RSP) is healthy and at highs, which is bullish. However, the growth-heavy Nasdaq is still below its prior peak, and the speculative AI complex is under distribution. "The averages are holding well, very tight... but it's almost a mask of what is really going on behind the curtain" (David Ryan). The short-term trader must be in the right sectors; long-term bulls can use the pause to accumulate leaders.

MPC.technical_action: Strong uptrend; Leaderboard added on an aggressive entry. Cleared 200 resistance. David Ryan bought a small position.
MPC.story: Refiner benefiting from constrained global supply and a favorable crack spread. "Very, very strong."

CRAK.technical_action: Pullback to 21-day, massive volume, RS rating 99.
CRAK.story: Oil Refiners ETF. A diversified way to play the strong refining group.

AVT.technical_action: Breakout on earnings, now consolidating tightly. RS line at new highs. Chris bought a week ago.
AVT.story: Electronic components/AI infrastructure. Character change after long sideways action; weekly chart looks powerful.

CRWD.technical_action: Held above 50-day during market weakness, pulled back inside, and have now resumed strong uptrends.
CRWD.story: Cybersecurity leaders. The textbook model for stocks to buy in this market—strong RS, constructive bases.

LFUS.technical_action: Broke below 50-day, made three lows, then surged on earnings. Now drifting quietly.
LFUS.story: Circuit protection/electronics. David Ryan's example of the ideal setup: tight, quiet consolidation after a strong move.

TWLO.technical_action: 25% correction, now back above 50-day, RS line at new highs. Chris prefers over FSLY.
TWLO.story: Communications software. A normal, constructive base with strong fundamentals.

CAH.technical_action: Strong earnings gap, now holding near highs. Earnings accelerating. David says it looks good.
CAH.story: Healthcare distributor (Cardinal Health). The leader in a group that also includes MCK and COR.

OLLI.technical_action: Undercut long-term low, then 8-9 days up in a row, reclaiming 50-day. David bought a small position.
OLLI.story: Discount retail. A classic undercut-and-rally setup showing institutional accumulation.

ELF.technical_action: Undercut prior low, then a massive string of up days.
ELF.story: Cosmetics. Another undercut-and-rally, showing that someone is aggressively accumulating.

KFY.technical_action: Emerging from long bases, hitting new highs.
KFY.story: Commercial staffing. A new group showing strength after years of going sideways.

DELL.technical_action: Wide and loose, 100-point swings. David Ryan has shorted it twice. Not a buy until it tightens up.
DELL.story: AI server. A "wild and loose sloppy base" is not where you buy. Wait for quiet.

NBIS.technical_action: Rejected three times at the declining 50-day.
NBIS.story: Neocloud/AI compute. David Ryan says until it gets above the 50-day, it's out of play.

SMH.technical_action: Rallied to declining 50-day, now rolling over. David is short.
SMH.story: Semiconductor ETF. A short on weak rallies; avoid for longs.

MU.technical_action: Stuck below 50-day and 21-day. Chris is fully hedged, waiting.
MU.story: Memory/AI leader. Needs to reclaim the 50-day; a break of the 787 low would be a sell.

CIEN.story: Optical networking. Potential short candidates on rallies into the 50-day.

PLTR.technical_action: Gap up on earnings, above 200-day. Chris waiting for a shelf or pullback to enter. Hatman has a position.
PLTR.story: AI analytics. A character change from short to potential leader.
